strings.name: Peter Handke
strings.summary: Born in Carinthia, Handke left law studies for fiction and unconventional drama. Offending the Audience, The Goalie's Anxiety at the Penalty Kick and A Sorrow Beyond Dreams examine daily life through language, perception and family experience; he also writes screenplays and translates. He won the 2019 Nobel Prize. His positions on the Balkan wars and speech at Milošević's 2006 funeral remain controversial, and the Nobel award prompted protests and boycotts.
